Heroin, Pistols, Drone Seized Near India-Pakistan Border

Authorities seized 10 kilograms of heroin, 11 pistols, and a drone near the India-Pakistan border. The operation occurred in Bikaner and is described as a major bust, with reports emphasizing its timing before August 15th. The seized items are believed to have been smuggled via drone from across the border.
